# Joke Languages, Counted

A list of languages built to be funny, not useful. Brainfuck has eight symbols and I have already written about it, so I will not do it twice. Next to the counter sketch: every joke language is a small rule set that turns into a larger, sillier one. I wrote this from memory, not from a trip, so take it as my own sketch of the idea. Lesson learned: a list of languages is still just a list, and I am still counting.
